blocks.action: Tune, settle posture, play a relaxed warm-up.
Repeat one current practical drill slowly.
Read a small part of a lesson, then demonstrate it on the bass.
Apply the idea to an original study or an appropriate groove.
Do a short ear drill, record an observation and choose the next target.
Repeat one current drill with the pulse.
Listen and write one specific observation.
